kinds.a: vannamei · white shrimp · Pacific white shrimp · crevette bleue
kinds.d: Whiteleg or white shrimp (Litopenaeus), the most widely farmed shrimp; packs that name no species usually hold it.
Black tiger prawn Penaeus monodon, sold raw or cooked, whole or peeled.
Large prawns sold under the trade names king prawn or banana prawn, names that may cover several species.
Northern or sweet prawn Pandalus borealis, small cold-water prawn sold raw or cooked.
Argentine red shrimp Pleoticus muelleri, sold frozen whole or peeled.

kinds.a: pink shrimp · brown shrimp (US) · royal red
kinds.d: Wild shrimp of the US Gulf of Mexico and Atlantic coast, sold raw or frozen, whole or peeled.
Spot prawn Pandalus platyceros, sold whole, raw or frozen.
Small brown or grey shrimp Crangon crangon, sold cooked and peeled or potted.
Giant river prawn Macrobrachium rosenbergii, sold whole.

notes: Restraint only. 14 old species kinds cut to the nine planned market kinds. White shrimp renamed Whiteleg shrimp; 'Prawns or shrimp, species not named' and Blue shrimp folded into it as types. Pink, Gulf brown and royal red shrimp merged into Gulf shrimp; king and banana prawn merged. Raw/cooked, shell-on/peeled, head-on, size count, wild/farmed and ASC/MSC are types. No old models; nothing dropped; no new kinds, no web research.
